description: A script for processing COVID-19 daily report CSV files, creating and publishing MISP events with aggregated or detailed data, including attributes like country, province, confirmed cases, deaths, recoveries, and active cases.

classes.name: MISPEvent
classes.description: Represents a MISP event, used to organize attributes and objects related to a specific report.

classes.name: MISPOrganisation
classes.description: Represents an organization in MISP, used when creating feed data.

classes.name: PyMISP
classes.description: Main class for interacting with the MISP API.

classes.name: MISPObject
classes.description: Represents an object within a MISP event, used to structure detailed report data.

methods.name: get_country_region
methods.description: Extracts the country or region name from a data row.

methods.name: get_last_update
methods.description: Parses and returns the last update timestamp from a data row.

methods.name: add_detailed_object
methods.description: Adds attributes to a MISPObject based on a data row, including location and case counts.

methods.name: country_aggregate
methods.description: Aggregates COVID-19 data by country from multiple rows.
